description: React Native component for language selection and localization management, including modal UI for language choice, persistent storage, and dynamic language switching.

methods.name: selectedLanguageFunc
methods.description: Initializes language settings based on stored preferences, updates UI and localization accordingly.

methods.name: handleModalOpen
methods.description: Opens language selection modal and sets current language selection based on stored preferences.

methods.name: onSelectedLanguage
methods.description: Handles user confirmation of language change, updates localization, storage, and UI.
